artworks.title: Statue of Isis
artworks.description: Albacini’s Hermitage marble continues the Greco-Roman Isis who crossed from Egypt into the Mediterranean mystery cults — the same goddess Ovid later plants in a Cretan temple to answer Telethusa and remake Iphis. Neoclassical polish keeps Isis as a classical deity of salvation, not a tourist Tutankhamun prop.

artworks.title: Isis and Iphis
artworks.description: Baur’s Ovid plate stages Isis transforming Iphis — the miracle that unlocks the marriage to Ianthe in Metamorphoses IX. Baroque line is the atlas’s closest visual of the Egyptian goddess as she appears in our Cretan dossier.
